row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (quote by learner count; no public tiers)
row.scim_addon_price_text: Paid add-on; price not published (Contact Client Success)
row.evidence: Absorb's Client Settings help article lists "SCIM Settings" as a "Paid add-on" ("Options marked as Paid add-on require purchase before they can be activated"); the SCIM 2.0 Provisioning Overview documents Users and Groups under scim/v2/ for Okta and Azure.
row.notes: Quote-only: Absorb publishes no plans or prices (the pricing page is a quote form keyed on learner count), so team and SCIM prices are null; SCIM is also explicitly a paid add-on. New row. absorblms.com now redirects to absorbai.com; the product is still Absorb LMS. SCIM is a paid add-on (Client Settings table: 'SCIM Settings | Paid add-on'), as is SSO Configuration; Webhooks are a free add-on. SCIM 2.0: Users (create, read, PUT, PATCH, soft-delete DELETE; active=false sets Inactive), Groups (map to flat Departments under the root), Schemas; no ServiceProviderConfig, ResourceTypes, Bulk or /Me. Auth is OAuth 2.0 authorization code (Okta; 4-hour access token, 1-year refresh token) or a long-lived bearer token valid to 2037 (Azure). Okta and Azure/Entra setup guides are login-only. The Integration API (REST, docs.myabsorb.com) needs a separate API subscription and private key, so api_tax is true.

auth.token_source: Client Settings > SCIM Settings card (OAuth client ID/secret) after enabling 'Enable SCIM' in Portal Settings; long-lived bearer token generated by a System Admin in the Admin Interface
auth.token_expiry: OAuth: access token 4 hours, refresh token 1 year; long-lived bearer token valid until 2037
auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow is used with Okta; the long-lived bearer token with Azure. Generating a new bearer token does not invalidate existing ones.

operations.notes: Reactivate = set active true (inactivation is reversible). Groups create Departments; members carried on the group resource.

deprovision.data_retained: active=false sets the User to Inactive: cannot log in to Learner or Admin Experience, cannot be enrolled; enrollment data, scores, certificates and history preserved and reactivatable. DELETE is a soft delete, recoverable via Support.

filtering.notes: Operators eq, ne, co, sw, ew, gt, ge, lt, le, pr with and/or/not; Schemas endpoint does not support filtering. Attribute list is illustrative (any attribute).

custom.how: Absorb extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:absorb:2.0:User with location, dateHired, gender, customFields (Absorb Custom Fields) and userManagementSettings (isLearner, isAdmin, isReviewer, isManager, isInstructor, adminRoles, managerRoles, managedDepartments, directReportIds)

attributes.notes: Core list beyond the overview table comes from the UserResponse/PostUserRequest definitions in the SCIM API reference.

roles.how: userManagementSettings in the Absorb extension (admin roles, manager roles); Admin Role sync added for Okta and Azure

limitations.text: ServiceProviderConfig, ResourceTypes and Bulk are not implemented; some IdPs probe ServiceProviderConfig and report a failure.
Group provisioning creates a flat Department structure one level under the root.
A default Department must be configured or user creation fails.
PATCH supports only add, replace and remove.

scim.notes: The help-centre overview lists Groups as create/read/update, while the SCIM API reference also documents DELETE /scim/v2/Groups/{id} (soft delete).

user_api.base_url: https://rest.myabsorb.com (US; CA, EU, AU and sandbox gateways also listed)

auth.notes: API private key (x-api-key) plus an API token from POST /authenticate with Admin credentials (4 hours); 'modern authentication' sends Authorization: Bearer. Up to 10 API keys per Portal.

endpoints.purpose: Upsert user by username or external ID
Create/update up to 200 users per request

limitations.text: Integration API access must be enabled by Absorb (separate subscription and API private key); webhooks are a free add-on.

okta.notes: OIN search shows 'AbsorbLMS' (SAML) and 'Absorb Anywhere' (SWA); provisioning comes from Absorb's 'Absorb SCIM in Okta' guide and connector change log (OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, which OIN SCIM apps use). The OIN card itself only shows a SAML badge.

entra.notes: The Entra gallery app is SSO-only (Microsoft's tutorial: provisioning is manual). Absorb's own 'Absorb SCIM in Azure' guide (login-only) provisions with a long-lived bearer token, so row idp.entra is via_generic.

fallbacks.other_sync: Direct HRIS integrations (ADP, BambooHR, Namely, Salesforce) and paid Connectors
fallbacks.notes: SAML account provisioning creates the user at first access and can update them on each login; it does not deactivate. Bulk user upload is via /users/upload and data imports. HRIS list is from the Choose Your Integration Approach article.
